## Mission Statement

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="25%"}
![](https://static-prod-us-east-1.campusgroups.com/upload/cwru/2026/image_4860193_drawing_80d3b58e-3135-4be6-9c24-3ec7e853771b_124232611.png)
:::
::: {.column width="75%"}

The mission of the Techanical Philosophy Club is to:

- Foster a community exploring the philosophical dimensions of technology
- Provide a forum for critical examination of technical systems and paradigms and their societal implications
- Promote interdisciplinary dialogue between philosophy, computer science, engineering, and related fields within the university community
:::
:::

## Events

- Weekly readings and discussions
- Watching talks together
- Going to conventions (like those of the open source foundation) that have a focus on higher level discussion
- Have guest speakers including CWRU professors like Prof. Loui!
- Debate GBs on pre-decided topics

## Uniqueness

- Totally novel - no clubs like this currently on campus
- Distinct from: Cybercwru, CCC, Quantum

None of the other clubs on campus discuss the philosophy behind the skills!

## Why we want to incorporate

- Being able to reserve spaces on campus
- Being able to put up fliers and advertise events as an official club org
- Google group for email and CG discoverability
- Guest parking for external speakers
- Funding to support our events
- Maybe case cash readers for merch?

## Continuity Plan

- Flyers and advertisments for larger events
- Proactively training members to be future exec members
- Maintaining documents on how the club is run
- Collaborations with other clubs to both benefit their members and grow our club
- Yearly elections following the academic cycle
